source: The `industry` column of the client's test workbook (client_documents/20260917 Senseigigs_NUS_Test_Dataset_Team31.xlsx, 'Hirer Gig Descriptions', 30 gigs), collapsed into groups. Entries marked "origin": "corpus" are not in that list; they were added because the crawled corpus (mostly consulting-firm pages) has a lot of work in those sectors, which would otherwise all land in OTHER.
note: Replaces subject_v1 (the academic-subject taxonomy from SenseigigsDoc1.pdf). Tagged on 30 of the client's own gigs, subject_v1 put 21 of them into Mathematics, Accountancy or Law, so it could not separate the kind of work the client cares about. The subject_v1 manifest is archived in docs/archive/2026-09-21/subject_v1/.

industries.name: Food & Beverage
industries.gist: Restaurants, hawker and food-court stalls, cafes, franchises, central kitchens, catering, food and drink manufacturing, food import and distribution.

industries.name: Construction & Real Estate
industries.gist: Building and civil construction, M&E and fit-out contracting, renovation, property development, real estate investment and facilities management.

industries.name: Financial Services
industries.gist: Banks, payments and fintech, insurance, asset and wealth management, capital markets, lending, and regulated financial institutions generally.

industries.name: Manufacturing
industries.gist: Factories and industrial production: precision engineering, electronics, chemicals and materials, automotive and aerospace production, industrial automation (Industry 4.0). Food manufacturing belongs to Food & Beverage.

industries.name: Logistics & Distribution
industries.gist: Freight, shipping and trucking, warehousing, supply chain operations, transport operators, wholesale trading and distribution.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.gist: Hospitals, clinics, GP and specialist practices, dental, traditional Chinese medicine, allied health, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and life sciences.

industries.name: Marine & Offshore
industries.gist: Shipyards, ship repair and building, vessel operators, offshore platforms and offshore support services, port and marine services.

industries.name: Technology & Software
industries.gist: Software products and SaaS, IT services and outsourcing, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI companies, telecoms and digital platforms.

industries.name: Retail & Consumer
industries.gist: Shops and e-commerce, consumer brands, beauty and wellness, personal and pet services, hospitality and travel.

industries.name: Professional Services
industries.gist: Law firms, accounting and audit practices, consultancies, recruitment, marketing and design agencies -- when the CLIENT is itself a professional firm, not when a consultancy merely published the page.

industries.name: Engineering Services
industries.gist: Engineering consultancies and contractors selling design, testing, inspection and technical services to other businesses.

industries.name: Social Services & Non-profit
industries.gist: Charities, NGOs, voluntary welfare organisations, social enterprises, elder care, children's and family services, community programmes.

industries.name: Energy & Resources
industries.gist: Oil and gas, power generation and utilities, renewables, mining and natural resources, environmental and waste services.

industries.name: Public Sector
industries.gist: Government ministries and agencies, statutory boards, defence, public infrastructure bodies and international development organisations.

industries.name: Education
industries.gist: Schools, universities, training providers and education technology. A training-focused social enterprise belongs to Social Services & Non-profit.

industries.name: Cross-industry
industries.gist: The work is not tied to any one sector: a profile whose expertise is explicitly generic or spans many industries evenly, or an engagement whose client sector is never stated or implied.

industries.name: OTHER
industries.gist: The work clearly belongs to one specific sector that none of the industries above covers. Name that sector in other_industry.
